newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria's Vranitzky will resign - Austrian TV.
newsitem.headline: Austria's Vranitzky will resign - Austrian TV.

text.p: Austrian Chancellor Franz Vranitzky will resign on Saturday, Austrian state television reported.
It said Vranitzky had told a television reporter that he would be resigning.
Vranitzky added it had not yet been decided who would be his successor, TV said.
Senior leaders of Vranitzky's Social Democrats had convened for an emergency session at 4 p.m. local (1500 GMT) amid growing signs Vranitzky would offer his resignation after 10 years in office.
Austrian media reported on Saturday that Finance Minister Viktor Klima was likely to be appointed as Vranitzky's successor.
A senior source inside his party earlier on Saturday told Reuters that the reports were "not far from the truth".
